requirements.text: Render the authoritative workload Direct-BGP admission ceilings into one immutable online-serving ConfigMap.
Require every online-serving role to validate the same trusted Phase 40 admission environment bundle at startup.
Use the trusted maxBgps ceiling instead of the Phase 40.7 classifier default for query Direct-BGP validation.
Use the trusted maxTriplesPerBgp ceiling instead of the Phase 40.7 classifier default for query Direct-BGP validation.
Use the trusted classification CPU ceiling while additionally capping effective lanes by visible CPU and the Rust compute-thread budget.
Emit a deterministic SHA-256 identity for the trusted online admission ceiling bundle.
Make query and distributed fragment-worker pods consume the same immutable admission ConfigMap without changing fragment semantic execution.
Leave the offline distributed ingestion/build worker outside Direct-BGP admission because that workload does not execute SPARQL Direct BGPs.
Preserve Phase 40.11 reference-worker exact ceiling enforcement unchanged.
Keep operator and distributed-operator generated-job propagation deferred to Phase 40.13.
Preserve every Phase 40.11 parent payload unless checksum-accounted in the Phase 40.11 to 40.12 inheritance record.
Keep full OWL Direct standards claims disabled until cumulative/native/W3C qualification is complete.
